label: SaaS Integrations
seoTitle: SaaS integration platforms for AI agents
descriptionMd: Connector platforms that let agents authenticate with and take governed actions across third-party SaaS products.
definitionMd: This category covers broad connector catalogs and integration platforms whose primary value is giving agents usable actions across external business applications.
scopeMd: Includes broad, maintained connector catalogs and common agent interfaces that manage authentication, authorization, schema discovery, and actions across external business applications.
inclusionMd:
- The platform exposes maintained connectors or action catalogs designed for agent tool use.
- Authentication, user authorization, and action execution are handled as substantive platform capabilities.
- The agent can discover or invoke integrations through a documented common interface.
exclusionMd:
- It offers only one product integration or a thin connector wrapper.
- It is a conventional automation platform with no material agent-first interaction model.
selectionGuideMd:
- Which applications and actions are covered?
- How are user authorization and credential boundaries enforced?
- Can agents discover schemas, errors, and required approvals programmatically?
useCases: Give agents governed access to multiple SaaS applications
Discover available actions and schemas through one interface
Apply user authorization and approval boundaries to agent actions
Handle integration errors consistently across tools

sources.title: Composio documentation overview
sources.claim: Composio documents tool discovery, per-user authentication, and action execution across a broad catalog of application toolkits for agents.
